same_object_policy: All methods within a case share field, initial state, horizon and reference. Central4 is absent from damped cases.
control_policy: Existing material-A four-group restoration/tracking trials are unchanged; no saturation, hardware calibration or new physical experiment is asserted.

provenance.parameter_policy: Material A is the sole physical baseline. B's display-precision old-v10 values are not loaded.
provenance.structure_policy: Ideal implicit/conjugated tangents evaluated at floating-point states; no assertion that finite Newton code is exactly structure preserving.
